deepdiving.ponder.compressor.text_1: Power the rear shaft at 16 RPM or faster. More speed produces and fills gas faster.
deepdiving.ponder.compressor.text_2: Keep the top intake above water. A submerged intake stops compression.
deepdiving.ponder.compressor.text_3: Extract compressed air with powered Create pumps and pipes, or attach a gas vessel directly.
deepdiving.ponder.compressor.text_4: In the menu, put a cylinder in In. Completed cylinders move to Out for collection or bottom-hopper extraction.
deepdiving.ponder.separator.text_1: Feed compressed air into the top inlet and power the rear shaft at 16 RPM or faster.
deepdiving.ponder.separator.text_2: Oxygen leaves the blue-marked port. Every 100 mB of air yields 21 mB of oxygen.
deepdiving.ponder.separator.text_3: Nitrogen leaves the green-marked port: the remaining 79 mB. Keep the two gases in separate vessels.
deepdiving.ponder.separator.text_4: Both output buffers need space. Empty storage vessels do not make gas; the separator needs compressed air.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_1: Feed oxygen into the blue-marked port. Power the rear shaft at 16 RPM or faster.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_2: Feed nitrogen into the green-marked port. The selected mixture determines how much is used.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_3: Helium enters from the top. Mixtures with no helium do not need a helium supply.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_4: Use the menu presets, or adjust oxygen and helium in 1% steps. Nitrogen fills the remaining percentage.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_5: A different mixture requires an empty cylinder. Purge discards its gas; useful partial input buffers can still fill it.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_6: Check the mixture depth range and cylinder pressure rating before diving. A full cylinder can still contain the wrong gas.
deepdiving.ponder.storage.text_1: Each vessel stores 64,000 mB of one gas. All faces accept Create pipes and pumps.
deepdiving.ponder.storage.text_2: Insert a helium cartridge in the menu to add 1,000 mB. A vessel holding another gas rejects it.
deepdiving.ponder.storage.text_3: Engineer's Goggles show the stored gas and quantity. Display Links can report it to a board.
deepdiving.ponder.storage.text_4: Sneak-wrench pickup preserves the gas and items. Place the vessel again to reconnect it.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_1: Wear a Create diving helmet and equip a filled Deep Diving cylinder in your chest slot.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_2: The helmet draws breathing gas directly from your cylinder. Only the selected supply is drained.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_3: Sneak-use a filled spare in your hand to enable backup. Keep it in your inventory for automatic takeover.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_4: Carry a computer for the HUD. Use it to inspect gas time, ascent guidance and the recovery guide.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_5: Check gas depth range and cylinder pressure rating. Backups supply gas; they do not increase equipment pressure limits.
deepdiving.ponder.charts.text_1: Use a new Depth Map once to initialize it. Hold it while exploring water to survey the bottom.
deepdiving.ponder.charts.text_2: Use a Dive Map Bundle to open it. Shift-click initialized depth maps into its 16 chart slots.
deepdiving.ponder.charts.text_3: Flip pages with the arrow buttons or Left and Right keys. Only the selected map surveys while the bundle is held.
deepdiving.ponder.charts.text_4: Name a Dive Site Sign, then use a map or bundle on it. The site's label is added to the selected map.
deepdiving.ponder.charts.text_5: Take a map out for cartography or an item frame. Its survey, name, scale and markers stay with the same map.
deepdiving.ponder.logbook.text_1: Carry a Dive Log Book and a Diving Computer. The book records the computer's readings during a session.
deepdiving.ponder.logbook.text_2: Use the book and choose Start dive. Carry it throughout the dive, then choose End dive when finished.
deepdiving.ponder.logbook.text_3: Browse the latest 32 dives with the page arrows. Review depth, gas use, ascent and warning types.
deepdiving.ponder.logbook.text_4: Keep the book and computer in your inventory. Removing either interrupts the recording.
